draft.subject: Getting the Blue Analytics team into Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Glad Wrenfield is landing well so far, and thanks for your patience on the downgrade timing question -- that ticket is still open and you'll have a proper answer on it shortly.

On getting the rest of the team added: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. It's also worth having a project in place first, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them.

Want to grab 15 minutes this week? I'll help you get the first project and the team invites sorted in one sitting.

Best,
Priya
